	trait = diligent

		birth = yes
	}
	669.11.14 = {
		death = yes
	}
	701.1.1 = {
		effect_even_if_dead = {
			pam_canonize_saint_effect = {
				CANONIZER = root
				CANDIDATE = root
				CONSECRATION_PROVINCE = province:13769 # Uda, for the Tanzan Shrine on Tonomine, where he is the Great Bright Kami of Tanzan
				PRESET = yes
			}
			religion:shintoism_religion = {
				every_faith = {
					limit = {
						MB_shinto_universal_saint_faith_trigger = yes
						main_rite = { is_rite_enabled = yes }
						NOT = { has_saint_character = root }
					}
					add_saint = { character = root }
				}
			}
			if = { # No relics: the dead body is a pollution kept far from the shrines of the kami
				limit = {
					title:c_yamato.holder ?= { faith = { has_saint_character = character:japanese_fujiwara_24 } }
				}
				title:c_yamato.holder = {
					consume_saint_relic_charge = character:japanese_fujiwara_24
					consume_saint_relic_charge = character:japanese_fujiwara_24
					consume_saint_relic_charge = character:japanese_fujiwara_24
					consume_saint_relic_charge = character:japanese_fujiwara_24
				}
				set_global_variable = MB_norelic_japanese_fujiwara_24
			}
		}
	}
}
